mapper.sql: id, client_request_id, content, reference_at, zone_id, status, error_message, attempt_count, completed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO capture_inputs (id, client_request_id, content, source, captured_at, reference_at, zone_id, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{requestId}, #{content}, 'AI', #{referenceAt}, #{referenceAt}, #{zoneId}, 'PROCESSING') ON CONFLICT (client_request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE capture_inputs SET status='PROCESSING', error_message=NULL, completed_at=NULL, attempt_count=attempt_count+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='FAILED'
UPDATE capture_inputs SET status='SUCCEEDED', error_message=NULL, completed_at=#{completedAt}, updated_at=#{completedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE capture_inputs SET status='FAILED', error_message=#{errorMessage}, completed_at=#{completedAt}, updated_at=#{completedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_records (id, project_id, content, occurred_at, capture_input_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{content}, #{occurredAt}, #{inputId})
INSERT INTO todo_items (id, project_id, title, notes, due_at, priority, capture_input_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{title}, #{notes}, #{dueAt}, #{priority}, #{inputId})
mapper.select: SELECT wr.id, wr.project_id, p.name project_name, wr.content, wr.occurred_at FROM work_records wr LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id=wr.project_id WHERE wr.capture_input_id=#{inputId} ORDER BY wr.created_at, wr.id

SELECT t.id, t.project_id, p.name project_name, t.title, t.notes, t.due_at, t.priority, t.version FROM todo_items t LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id=t.project_id WHERE t.capture_input_id=#{inputId} ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id
